title: ‘Let’s see what he can do’: will Burnham bring voters back in Labour heartlands?

paragraphs.en: Labour marked its worst performance in more than 50 years when voters went to the polls in Barnsley in May, but 100 days on from those seismic local elections, the political landscape has shifted drastically.
paragraphs.zh: 5月巴恩斯利选民投票时，工党遭遇了50多年来最差的表现，但在这场影响深重的地方选举过去100天后，政治格局已发生翻天覆地的变化。

paragraphs.en: Could the South Yorkshire town, where Reform UK reaped the benefits of dissatisfaction with Labour, prove to be a test case for whether the governing party has turned the tide?
paragraphs.zh: 在这个南约克郡的小镇，英国改革党因选民对工党的不满而获益。该镇能否成为检验执政党是否已扭转局势的试金石？

paragraphs.en: Labour had run Barnsley’s council since its inception in 1974, but was left with just 11 councillors after Reform triumphed with 42 seats.
paragraphs.zh: 自1974年议会成立以来，工党一直掌控巴恩斯利市议会，但改革党以42个席位大获全胜后，工党仅剩下11名议员。

paragraphs.en: “I knew that it would be the most challenging set of elections that we’ve ever faced in Barnsley’s history,” said the councillor James Higginbottom, the new Labour group opposition leader. “What I didn’t necessarily expect was the scale of the Reform victory.”
paragraphs.zh: 新的工党反对党团领袖、议员詹姆斯·希金博顿说：“我料到这将是巴恩斯利历史上我们面临过的最具挑战性的一次选举。我未必预料到的是改革党胜利的规模。”

paragraphs.en: Catastrophic results in places such as Barnsley were a catalyst for Keir Starmer’s resignation. He has been replaced as prime minister by the former mayor of Greater Manchester Andy Burnham, who won the Labour leadership uncontested after a landslide byelection victory.
paragraphs.zh: 巴恩斯利等地的灾难性结果成为基尔·斯塔默辞职的催化剂。取代他出任首相的是大曼彻斯特前市长安迪·伯纳姆，后者在补选大获全胜后无悬念地赢得了工党领袖职位。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, the Reform leader, Nigel Farage, is facing scrutiny over his financial affairs. While he was decisively re-elected in Clacton on Thursday, after he called a byelection in protest over a parliamentary standards investigation into his financial gifts, the contest was largely viewed as a sideshow after other major parties declined to stand. The parliamentary standards investigation has now resumed .
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，改革党领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇正因其财务状况面临审查。他于周四在克拉克顿以压倒性优势再次当选，此前他因抗议议会就其财务馈赠进行的标准调查而发起补选。由于其他主要政党拒绝参选，这场竞选在很大程度上被视为一场插曲。目前，议会标准调查已恢复。

paragraphs.en: Labour is now ahead in the polls for the first time since March 2025, with a YouGov poll on Monday giving Labour a two-point lead, at 24 points to Reform’s 22.
paragraphs.zh: 工党目前在民调中的支持率自2025年3月以来首次领先。YouGov周一公布的民调显示，工党以24%对22%领先改革党两个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Many in Barnsley used their vote in May to punish Starmer’s government, and while almost everyone the Guardian spoke to there this week said it was too early to judge the Reform council on their record, the new national political picture appears to be enticing at least some back to Labour.
paragraphs.zh: 巴恩斯利的许多选民在5月用投票惩罚了斯塔默政府。尽管本周《卫报》在当地接触到的几乎所有人都表示，现在就根据改革党议会的政绩来评判为时尚早，但新的全国政治格局似乎至少正在吸引一些人回归工党。
